decisions.reason: Its vertical through contacts build directly on the firm's existing glass-silicon structuring and drilling/metallization know-how, so absorptive capacity supports improving it.
Handling smaller wafers is an incremental extension of the firm's established carrier-wafer line, which the firm can readily assimilate and refine.
The copper interposer wafer is a strategic focus that still draws on the firm's core glass structuring, coating and cleanroom-packaging capabilities.
The off-the-shelf brand repackages the firm's existing glass and quartz wafer products, so it requires little new knowledge and is highly aligned with current capabilities.
Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the firm's precision wafer and cleanroom-packaging knowledge, making it harder to interpret results and improve, so the firm likely exits.
